title: Catapult Cats
one_line_rule: Drag back from the slingshot and release to launch a cat in an arc.

brief.intent: Angry Birds style physics game where I launch cats at a tower of cardboard boxes
brief.notes: Drag to aim and release, gravity-driven arc and falling boxes.
